chunks.text: Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slow and easy English.
Today, we talk about a very small and beautiful town.
The town is Albarracin.
Albarracin is in Spain.
Spain is a country in Europe.
Albarracin is a quiet medieval town on a hill.
Part two, Albarracin is very small.
Only a few people live there.
The town is surrounded by mountains and nature.
It feels calm and peaceful.
Part three, Albarracin is very old.
It has a long history from the Middle Ages.
Many old buildings are still standing today.
The town looks like it is from the past.
Part four, the houses in Albarracin are red and pink.
They are made of stone and clay.
The color of the buildings matches the rocks around the town.
This makes the view very beautiful.
The streets in Albarracin are narrow and steep.
People walk up and down small paths.
There are many stairs and corners.
Walking in the town is like a small adventure.
Part six, Albarracin has strong city walls.
These walls protected the town long ago.
Some parts of the walls are still visible today.
Visitors can walk near them and see the history.
Part seven, there is also a castle in Albarracin.
The castle is on the highest point of the town.
From the castle, you can see the mountains and river.
The view is very quiet and beautiful.
Part eight, nature around Albarracin is very rich.
There are forests, rivers and rocks.
People enjoy hiking and walking in nature.
The air is fresh and clean.
Part nine, food in Albarracin is traditional Spanish food.
People eat meat, bread, cheese and vegetables.
One popular dish is roasted lamb.
Local restaurants are small and cozy.
The people in Albarracin are friendly.
Life is slow and simple.
People know each other well.
The town feels like a small family.
Part eleven, Albarracin is not a very famous tourist city.
But many people visit to see its beauty.
It is quiet and not crowded.
This makes it special for visitors.
Part twelve, Albarracin is a small town full of history and beauty.
The red houses, old castle and mountain views make it unique.
Visitors can feel peace and discover the past.
Even though it is very small, Albarracin is a wonderful place to see.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emili.
See you in the next episode.
